title: I have dreams of a recurring location, but the dream itself is always different.
content: I always end up in a commons area first, find my dorm/hotel room (I can’t tell, but it’s like a semi-futuristic door and furnishings). Everyone that i know or love lives in this big compound of dorm rooms. The city always looks the same but it feels like i’m getting a glimpse of someone elses life through my dreams
